name: navigate-place
title: Navigate to a place
description: Drive the holonomic base to a free stand-off pose next to a room, piece of furniture, support, articulated part or object. The arm is tucked when empty, or held in the compact carry pose with the load.
use_when: The robot must be in another room or next to another piece of furniture.

not_to_be_confused_with.approach: approach fine-parks so the arm reaches one target; navigate only gets near.
not_to_be_confused_with.retreat: retreat moves straight back from a place without a destination.

destination.description: Where to go: a room, furniture, support, articulated part or object.

base_pose.description: Measured base pose [x, y, yaw_deg] at arrival.

postconditions.name: base_near
postconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: base_near
checks.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_paths.note: An object held by both grippers moves at the slow bimanual carry speed.
Back off, lift the load to carry height, plan with extra clearance, drive slowly.

previous.when: the robot must leave after backing out
the robot drives after low work
the robot drives after a bent reach
after a failed manipulation, before driving on
the found object must be fetched
the object must be carried elsewhere
the object is carried over furniture

next.when: a manipulation target is on the destination
next.reason: navigate leaves the base near; approach makes the target IK-reachable.

next.when: the destination must be observed first

fallback.when: navigation fails because the base or load is wedged against furniture
fallback.reason: Backing out frees the planner's start cell, then navigate again.

fallback.when: navigation fails because the empty arm cannot fold
fallback.reason: A separately planned fold clears the arm before the base path.

fallback.when: a carried object hangs too low for the doorway clearance
fallback.reason: Raising the load restores the carry clearance.

fallback_for.when: no base pose near the current one reaches the target
the line of sight is blocked
the object is not visible from here

alternative.when: turning in place is blocked by furniture

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.

includes: stand-off pose search around the noun's footprint
excludes: arm reachability of a specific target
